trial_court: Court of the XXXVIII Additional City Civil & Sessions Judge, Bengaluru City [CCH-39]

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt.Y.Jayamma W/o late Muniyappa Reddy, Kum. ANASUYA, aged about 37 years, D/o late Muniyappa Reddy, Sri Lokesh, aged about 35 years, S/o late Muniyappa Reddy
parties.respondent_defendant: MUNI KRISHNA REDDY, Smt.M. JAYAMMA, Smt.LAKSHMI, Sri M.VENKATESH REDDY, Smt.JAYAMMA, Sri SRINIVASA REDDY, Sri.VEERENDRA KUMAR, Smt.GIRIJA, Smt.SHYALAJA

facts_of_case: Suit for declaration, partition and separate possession and for mesne profit filed by Plaintiffs against Defendants.

legal_principles.principle: A party who has executed a registered partition deed and taken his share in the family properties is estopped from pleading anything contrary to the statements of facts made in the said deed.
legal_principles.held: The Defendant No.1 is estopped from pleading that his father late Muniyappa Reddy had relationship with the 1st Plaintiff, and Plaintiff Nos.2 and 3 are born to late Muniyappa Reddy.

legal_principles.principle: A party who has acted upon a registered partition deed and altered his position based on the same is estopped from challenging the validity of the said deed.
legal_principles.held: The parties have acted upon the [partition deeds] and based on the partition, the parties have altered their positions and dealt with the properties.

legal_principles.principle: A party who has executed a registered document and taken his share in the family properties is estopped from pleading anything contrary to the statements of facts made in the said document.
legal_principles.held: The Defendant No.1 is estopped from pleading anything contrary to the statements of facts made in the aforesaid registered Partition Deeds Dt.31.3.2004 and 4.2.2005.

legal_principles.principle: A party who has introduced new facts or evidence after a long period of time is estopped from relying on the same.
legal_principles.held: The Plaintiffs have no right over any of the suit schedule properties mentioned in the schedule.
